newsitem.title: USA: FGIC qualifies six issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FGIC qualifies six issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co. said it qualified for insurance six bond issues slated for competitive sale on Tuesday.
--Cold Spring SD, Calif., $1.4 million of general obligation (GO) bonds.
--Petaluma City Elementary School, Calif., $4.5 million of GO bonds.
--Petaluma City High School, Calif., $10.7 million of GO bonds.
--Kenmore-Tonawanda SD, N.Y., $7.9 million of school district bonds.
--Harker Heights, Texas, $4.9 million of certificates of obligation.
